My general defense against all emotional reactions (Esspecially the negitive ones.)

First the montra. It is what it is, if it wasn't it wouldn't be.

Then, I try to maintain a constant mental state of "strolling through the park." Calm, bit of a grin, and enjoying the peaceful.

Finally, I try to read/hear everything as light hearted humor. Or at least cold data. If it's true, it's true. Is it something I can change? If yes, it's my fault it's true so change it or move on. If no, it is what it is. If it's not true, then they might as well have called me a purple pregnant unicorn.

Plus, I'm pretty sure I've developed an odd processing buffer. So something hits me and my head processes it before my body reacts and by then I'm calm. I think it's from years of people trying to get a reaction out of me and me being stubbornly not giving them the win. Nothing gives me more of a dishish victory than others failing to tickle me, scare me, bait me, manipulate me, or play me.
